answer: The Mechanism enforces a per-identity resource commitment where each new agent must contribute a unique shale-derived pigment sample verified against a meadow-grown baseline, incurring a non-recoverable verification fee. This process ensures that resource allocation remains consistent while maintaining the integrity of the system. The verification fee is tied to the identity of the agent, preventing any manipulation or duplication of resources. By requiring a shale-derived pigment sample, the Mechanism guarantees that each contribution is distinct and traceable.
